title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The access-control row incorrectly attributes the employee-data boundary to permission sets; Microsoft says partitions determine whose data users can see. Narrow that row to the capabilities its route actually controls. The roadmap targets, preview access defaults and licensing requirements are supported.

claims.claim: The permission-set route controls who receives access and whose employee data they can see.
claims.quote: A partition defines whose data users can see. A permission set or a partition on its own doesn't give anyone access. Users receive access only when they're assigned to an access policy.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].governs and the rendered row heading with 'Which dashboards users can open, whether they can export, and whether named users are visible'. Permission sets control capabilities, not employee-data partitions or policy assignments. Do not advertise this permission-set route as controlling whose data users can see.
